decisions.reason: The 1uF BOOT and EN timing capacitors do not change the panel connector inventory, reset-button connection, or on-board BOOT-button placement policy.
The source changes BOOT and EN capacitance values, not any ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment.
The capacitor-value decision does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module; module confirmation occurs separately in message 332.
BOOT and EN timing capacitance does not change the USB data lines or the USB-C programming-port role.
The source concerns the controller's BOOT and EN timing network, not the separate 5V boost converter enable control or its GPIO5 assignment.
The BOOT and EN capacitance selection does not alter LED power, data, level shifting, or standby-control requirements.
The controller timing capacitor values have no necessary effect on battery electrical-protection requirements.
The source does not change the battery NTC connector, function, or thermal-protection controller.
The BOOT and EN capacitor values do not change the charge-status LED interface or its component values.
The controller timing-network modification does not alter the sensor board's external connector-fanout role.
The shared capacitance terminology is incidental; BOOT and EN timing capacitors do not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, cable assumptions, or topology.
